description: This file defines the 'AclEntryModified' class, representing an event emitted after a modification to a Thing's ACL entry in an Eclipse Ditto-based IoT platform. It includes methods for construction, JSON serialization/deserialization, and access to the modified ACL entry. The class is annotated for immutability and event parsing, and it references various Ditto JSON and model classes.

classes.name: AclEntryModified
classes.description: An immutable event class representing the modification of a Thing's ACL entry, capable of serialization, deserialization, and building relevant JSON payloads.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an AclEntryModified instance with explicit parameters including thing ID, ACL entry, revision, timestamp, headers, and optional metadata.

methods.name: AclEntryModified.fromJson
methods.description: Creates an AclEntryModified instance from a JSON string or JSON object, with specified headers, deserializing the JSON content into class fields.

methods.name: getAclEntry
methods.description: Returns the ACL entry associated with this modification event.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for this ACL modification resource.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified revision value.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayloadAndBuild
methods.description: Adds the ACL entry payload to a JSON object builder for serialization, respecting schema version and predicate filtering.
